topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I opened the attic door, the creak a faint whisper against the silence. Up here, the world feels different, layered with tales told by shadows and dust. Each box, each forgotten item tucked away, reveals a story from years past. An old cassette player, its surface etched with time, sits beside a stack of carefully preserved letters, their edges curling with age. A child’s toy, still vibrant, gazes back with eyes wide open, as if waiting for playtime to resume. The attic is a vault of moments unseen, a repository of the past whispering through the stillness. I move among these relics, each step soft, each breath a silent dialogue with the echoes of those who once called this house home.
